name: Shitou Kaori
source:
The school nurse at [url=https://vndb.org/c4700]Ryou[/url]'s school. She got to know Ryou because he always comes to the nurse's office to take naps, but it appears she's known Ryou's sister [url=https://vndb.org/c4696]Ayame[/url] for a long time. Kaori is beautiful, but she talks like a guy, so most people don't know how to react to her.

[From [url=https://www.jastusa.com/crescendo.html]JAST USA[/url]]
